messages:
Jordan Park: Hey folks, hit a snag during initial setup. Okta + 1Password login worked, but when I try to access the 'team-models' Drive shared folder I get 'You need access' (403). Joined via onboarding earlier today. Anyone know where to check group membership? :confused:
Priya Patel: Welcome Jordan! Can you confirm the email shown in Drive (top-right) is your @redwood.com? Also paste the folder link here so I can inspect sharing settings.
Jordan Park: Yep it's jordan.park@redwood.com. Folder link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0BzyTeamModelsExample
it-provisioning-bot: Automated provisioning: okta_user_created for jordan.park@redwood.com at 2026-03-23T13:14:02Z; google_account_provisioned at 2026-03-23T13:15:10Z; password_manager_invite sent.
Samir Rao: Quick note: new-hires are temporarily put into 'eng-onboard' group. The models folder is shared to 'eng-core' group. If the onboarding sync hasn't promoted you to eng-core, you'll see that 403.
Priya Patel: I'll check the onboarding sync logs. Jordan, I can add you to eng-core manually to unblock you.
Alex M: If Priya adds you and you still see 403, sometimes Drive caches permissions for a few minutes. Try a hard refresh or incognito window.
Priya Patel: Added jordan.park@redwood.com to eng-core. I also queued a fix: job 'onboard-group-promote' failed a few runs due to token expiry; rotating creds now, running a catch-up for users provisioned in the past 2 hours.
Jordan Park: Tried incognito after the add  I can open the folder now. Thanks! :tada: One more question: for GitHub access, I didn't get an invite yet. Does SSO auto-add new hires?
Samir Rao: GitHub is separate. You should get an org invite by email once Priya or platform grants team membership. If you don't in ~15m, ping us and we'll send it manually. SSH keys need to be added by you. Example commands:
```
ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -C "jordan.park@redwood.com"
cat ~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub | pbcopy
```
Priya Patel: FYI we had a small passkey registration delay earlier today that affected some users' Okta MFA enrollment. If your Okta MFA looks wrong, go to Profile -> Extra Verification Methods and re-register. Ping me and I can do a live check.
Jordan Park: Great, will do. Thanks everyone for the quick help, super smooth besides that. :wave:
